CA.rationale: Content (candidate red) is explicitly paired with a processing/origin condition at the same candidate represented_time.

COD.rationale: Content (red at p0/current/n0), its presentation (coordinate) and a distinct origin/status entry are all explicitly present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: A processing/estimation condition (command_estimate) is explicitly associated with the candidate content at the candidate represented_time.

C.rationale: Multiple entries identify specific content attributes (red/blue) bound to coordinate sets in named records/times.

D.rationale: Content (red coordinates) is reported separately from a distinct origin/status field for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: The report states the grid orientation and gives organized coordinate sets for content, describing presentation/organization.
